$comment: Verified 1447H secondary-stage study plan for Jazira. Research notes and full citations: docs/research/curriculum-secondary.md. Scope: high-school stage only. Ids mirror src/lib/curriculum.js; new ids are proposals. name_en values are working translations, not official. periods_per_year_max = the plan's 'حد أعلى' column (periods per academic year). Access date for every URL: 2026-09-25.

evidence.states: SPA, 11 Safar 1447 / 5 Aug 2025: the Ministry welcomed the Cabinet's approval of two semesters (فصلين دراسيين) for general-education schools for the coming academic year 1447/1448H.
MoE news page (dated 11/02/1447) carrying the same announcement: two semesters for general-education schools for the coming academic year 1447/1448H.

conflicting_official_text.states: The MoE 'المسارات الثانوية' page (last updated 21/04/1447) still describes the pathways system as nine semesters over three years (تسعة فصول دراسية) — legacy three-term wording that predates the Aug 2025 decision.

per_subject_split.reason: The official 1447 plan (guide, 5th edition) allocates periods per ACADEMIC YEAR, not per semester (p.11: plans restructured around total periods during the school year; tables on pp.28-40 are headed 'عدد الحصص الدراسية خلال العام الدراسي'). Rule 10 (p.14) only requires multi-level subjects to be taught in order within the year (level 1 before level 2; مبادئ القانون before تطبيقات في القانون). No official per-semester distribution for secondary was found, and the official textbook portal (ien.edu.sa) redirected to a maintenance page on the access date, so textbook-by-semester listings could not be checked. Every subject's `terms` value is therefore unverified: existing catalog items keep their current value; new items default to ["t1","t2"] as a placeholder.

stages.structure_note: Official 1447 documents name the stage 'الثانوية العامة': a common first year (السنة الأولى) followed by two years in one of five tracks (المسارات التخصصية).

plan_totals.arithmetic_note: Subject rows sum to 1152; with activity (60) and non-class periods (216) that is 1428, but the printed total is 1368 (= 1152 + 216). Reported as printed.

official_sources.name: دليل الخطط الدراسية — الإصدار الخامس (المركز الوطني للمناهج، منشور على موقع وزارة التعليم)
official_sources.evidence: Primary source for all subject lists and period counts (pp.25-40). Linked from the MoE study-plans page (last updated 21/04/1447). The extracted text contains no licence or redistribution terms; moe.gov.sa site terms apply. Study-plan facts are an official document/facts (Copyright Law art. 4).

official_sources.name: وزارة التعليم — خدمة مقرراتي (المقررات الدراسية)
official_sources.evidence: The MoE e-service gives students, teachers and supervisors a digital copy of the textbooks through منصة مدرستي; requires an active Madrasati account; alternative channels: منصة مدرستي ونظام عين. No redistribution permission stated. Page last updated 06/01/1447.

official_sources.name: منصة مدرستي
official_sources.evidence: Login-gated; not accessed beyond the public entry URL (no login attempted).

official_sources.name: عين الإثرائية (بوابة التعليم الوطنية)
official_sources.evidence: On 2026-09-25 www.ien.edu.sa and /Home/Dashbord returned HTTP 302 to https://maintenance.moe.gov.sa. The live auth.ien.edu.sa page carries the portal's terms: users agree to use Ain services and their content only for educational purposes; footer: all rights reserved to شركة تطوير للخدمات التعليمية © 2026. No licence to copy or rehost is granted ('all rights reserved' = rights not granted), hence classified as prohibited absent written permission.

official_sources.name: عين — صفحة الشروط والسياسات (نطاق auth)
official_sources.evidence: Same terms text as above, read directly from the page HTML on 2026-09-25.

official_sources.name: وزارة التعليم — خبر تحميل الكتب الرقمية عبر بوابة عين
official_sources.evidence: Dated 05/01/1440: describes downloading digital textbooks from ien.edu.sa by choosing education type, stage, grade, semester and subject. Old (pre-1447) but the only official description of the portal's navigation found.

official_sources.name: وزارة التعليم — الشروط والأحكام والسياسات
official_sources.evidence: Portal content is provided for the user's personal use 'as is'; any public or interactive use of the portal grants the user no rights, licences or privileges; users must not publish material that infringes others' intellectual property. No explicit redistribution clause either way (page last updated 03/04/1448).

official_sources.name: نظام حماية حقوق المؤلف (هيئة الخبراء بمجلس الوزراء)
official_sources.evidence: Royal Decree M/41 of 2/7/1424 (in force). Art.2 protects written works such as books; art.9 reserves to the author/assignee printing, publication and communication to the public including over information networks; art.15 exceptions (personal copying, attributed quotation, limited non-commercial educational illustration) do not cover rehosting whole textbooks; art.4 excludes official documents, administrative decisions and bare facts from protection.

official_sources.name: المركز الوطني للمناهج
official_sources.evidence: NCC's remit includes building curricula and study plans and approving and licensing them (اعتمادها والترخيص لها). Footer: all rights reserved 2025. Its licensed-books register is at https://www.sncc.gov.sa/licensed_books_ar.html (data last updated 2026-09-09).
